title: Addressing A Posteriori Performance Degradation in Neural Network Subgrid Stress Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.17475v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural network subgrid stress models often have a priori performance that is far better than the a posteriori performance, leading to neural network models that look very promising a priori completely failing in a posteriori Large Eddy Simulations (LES). This performance gap can be decreased by combining two different methods, training data augmentation and reducing input complexity to the neural network. Augmenting the training data with two different filters before training the neural networks has no performance degradation a priori as compared to a neural network trained with one filter. A posteriori, neural networks trained with two different filters are far more robust across two different LES codes with different numerical schemes. translated_title: 解决神经网络亚格子应力模型的后验性能退化问题
translated_abstract: 神经网络亚格子应力模型的先验性能往往远优于后验性能，导致一些先验评估中看起来非常有前景的神经网络模型在后验大涡模拟（LES）中完全失败。这种性能差距可以通过结合两种不同的方法来缩小：训练数据增强和降低神经网络的输入复杂度。在训练神经网络之前使用两种不同的滤波器对训练数据进行增强，与仅使用一种滤波器训练的神经网络相比，先验性能没有退化。而在后验测试中，使用两种不同滤波器训练的神经网络在两个采用不同数值格式的大涡模拟程序中表现出更强的鲁棒性。此外，通过消融掉输入神经网络的高阶项，先验与后验之间的性能差异变得不那么明显。当两种方法结合使用时，神经网络（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 通过结合双滤波器训练数据增强与消融高阶项以降低输入复杂度两种方法，可以有效缩小神经网络亚格子应力模型在先验与后验性能之间的差距，使其在不同数值格式的大涡模拟中表现更加鲁棒。
en_tdlr: Combining training data augmentation with two different filters and reducing input complexity by ablating higher-order terms narrows the a priori-a posteriori performance gap of neural network subgrid stress models, making them far more robust across LES codes with different numerical schemes.
